identity_basis: All SHA values are owner-provided immutable C5 inventory identities from the batch input and transfer accounting. No local rehash or independent integrity validation was performed.
method: Static text reads and tools.view_image on all eight assigned original files; no application, test, build, probe, SSH, copy, crop or image processing.

observations.geometry: Upper-right menu placement and four evenly spaced rows closely track the reference at its declared 2:1 physical scale.
observations.font: Menu labels are readable interface text; the Library heading and book titles retain their serif treatment.
observations.boundary: The complete menu border, four rows and underlying page boundary remain visible without text clipping.
observations.affordance: Refresh, Downloads, Selection and Manage Categories have distinct left-side symbols. The category symbol reads as three short strokes at this viewing scale; its reference bullet detail remains unresolved.

intentional_capability_checks: No intentional differences were declared. Queue count zero explains the absent reference sample badge of three.
C4-C5-G05 requires the Paperwhite list glyph; the retained manage-categories action ID is supported by frozen state, while precise bullet detail is pending.
The desktop capability declaration does not claim physical hardware qualification.
cases.static_verdict: pending_glyph_detail; no other actionable issue observed
cases.behavior_limits: The action record requests library/more at 650 ms. This establishes capture intent and the visible opened menu, not successful activation of any row, physical hit targets or touch behavior.

observations.geometry: The sheet boundary, four sort controls and status row follow the reference arrangement. The last three tag chips do not grow to fill the row. However, equivalent two-character tag chips are visibly about 79 native pixels wide versus about 64 in the reference after its declared 2:1 scale, reducing first-row capacity from eight to six.
observations.font: Labels and the loaded-count call to action are readable. The wider tag-chip interior leaves noticeably more horizontal whitespace around the same-length labels.
observations.boundary: All tags and the bottom action remain inside the sheet; no chip text is clipped.
observations.affordance: The open filter trigger remains white with zero active filters. Relevance is selected, Latest is available, and Follows and Rating are visibly muted.

intentional_capability_checks: C4-C5-G03 is supported: both the source caption and call to action describe the actual 128 already-loaded results, without asserting a remote grand total.
C4-C5-G08 is visibly supported by the neutral settled trigger, independently of the owner's mechanical pass.
Actual nine-tag content may differ from the reference sample, but that does not exempt chip geometry under C4-C5-G04.
Disabled Follows and Rating match frozen enabled=false declarations and are accepted capability bounds.
cases.behavior_limits: The action record requests catalog/filter-menu at 650 ms. No tag cycle, filter application, reset, result refresh or pagination interaction was performed. Width estimates are visual approximations, not measured pixel results.

observations.geometry: Five refresh-interval controls, three quality rows, three switch rows and the grayscale strip maintain the reference layout and spacing.
observations.font: The large serif heading and interface labels are readable; disabled quality and fixed-policy text are consistently muted.
observations.boundary: Group borders and separators are intact, with clear space above the bottom navigation and no clipped controls.
observations.affordance: Six is selected. Quality controls explicitly show unavailable status. Chapter refresh explicitly says fixed on and displays a black on-track with a right-side muted knob. Close-menu clearing is on and Night Mode is off.

intentional_capability_checks: C4-ACCEPT-04 permits truthful unavailable quality controls rather than reproducing the reference sample's enabled quality choice.
The fixed-on chapter policy is visibly on and unavailable for editing; no new user preference is inferred.
The close-menu switch follows actual flash_on_close=true rather than the sample reference state. Physical e-ink effects remain unqualified.
cases.behavior_limits: The action record only opens screen-refresh at 650 ms. It does not prove fixed-policy input rejection, switch persistence, native refresh timing or hardware effects.

observations.geometry: The source header, tabs, right-side search field, neutral filter button and five-column by three-row grid track the reference arrangement.
observations.font: Cover-external titles and status lines visibly use interface sans-serif forms. Lettering inside patterned or text-only covers remains part of the artwork. Long external titles use ellipsis within their cards.
observations.boundary: Cover rectangles, caption areas, pagination and bottom navigation remain separated without visible overlap.
observations.affordance: The current Browse destination, first page of nine, Next action, search field and neutral filter entry remain visually distinct; bookmark marks do not collide with the observed titles.

intentional_capability_checks: C4-C5-G15 is supported by rendered caption appearance; no runtime font-file or numeric weight measurement is claimed.

Actual source contents and the third-row text-only cover contents differ from the sample; frozen state declares settled cover work with no visible cover failures, so sample-title or cover substitutions are not requested.
C4-C5-G08 is supported by zero active filters and the neutral filter surface. The desktop declaration does not qualify pen, sensor or physical hardware behavior.
cases.behavior_limits: The captured actions file is empty. Search, source switching, pagination, bookmark behavior and physical interaction were not exercised.

actual_view.note: The tool resized its displayed rendering; the original file was opened and no derivative was created.

suggestions.trigger: Open the catalog filter sheet with the actual nine neutral tags.
suggestions.finding: The last row no longer stretches, but equivalent two-character tag chips remain visibly wider than the normalized original reference, with excess horizontal interior space.
suggestions.recommendation: Restore reference-aligned intrinsic chip padding while retaining actual tag content, tri-state semantics, wrapping and pagination.
suggestions.measurement_limit: Approximately 79 versus 64 native-scale pixels from visual comparison only; no automated measurement or computed geometry.

evidence_gaps.detail: The category glyph reads as three short horizontal strokes at the native viewing scale. The reference has separated left-side bullets; their presence or absence in C5 cannot be concluded reliably from this bounded view.
evidence_gaps.next_step: A coordinator-assigned fresh crop job is needed if precise bullet detail is required. This reviewer has exhausted the eight-image budget.

evidence_gaps.detail: A static read of the input-declared path returned file not found. Applicable contracts were read from input.root_contracts instead. The chip-width finding is a direct visual comparison; the exact separately declared padding value was not verified.

limitations: This is a four-case bounded static C5 review, not a full or clean qualification round.
Only frozen C5 files and applicable contracts were used; current production source and older C4 image verdicts were not used to infer C5 behavior.
Owner-reported mechanical pass values were supporting capture records and were not substituted for original-image viewing.
Screenshots and recorded actions do not prove physical touch, e-ink refresh effects, native mapping, timing, persistence or the independent live-reader lease.
Unsupported controls and fixed-on policies were evaluated as truthful capability bounds. No quality, sensor, pen or user-switching feature is requested.
No tests, local validation, runtime probes or image processing were performed; the report itself was not validated by a program.
